name: toolsenabled-slides
description: Create and edit local PowerPoint decks with a live studio, slide locks, lint and portable exports.

python_executable.title: Prepared Python executable
python_executable.description: Absolute path to the external venv Python created by tools/setup-runtime.py. No packages are installed at launch.

node_executable.title: Node.js executable
node_executable.description: Absolute path to an existing Node.js 22+ executable outside the workspace and plugin.

workspace_directory.title: Presentation workspace
workspace_directory.description: Absolute path to a dedicated workspace outside the plugin cache. Decks, assets and private state live here. Use a separate workspace and port per concurrent client.

port.title: Local studio port
port.description: Loopback port from 1024 through 65535, unused by other workspaces.

renderer.title: PDF and PNG renderer
renderer.description: Use auto or libreoffice on Linux. Native Windows and the experimental PowerPoint renderer are unsupported in this release.

libreoffice_executable.title: Optional LibreOffice executable
libreoffice_executable.description: Absolute path to LibreOffice soffice when it is outside PATH. Leave empty for automatic discovery.
